meta.name: Borealis
meta.author: dustycompiler
meta.cadence: GitHub Actions snapshot (not a guaranteed 15-minute tick; cron can drift or pause). STALE banner if snapshot age > 2 hours. On-page LIVE pulse: browser JSON-RPC to public Solana RPC (publicnode, mainnet-beta fallback) for slot/epoch/TPS at most every 60s. Snapshot values shown as NOT LIVE if RPC fails. Never invented.

live_pulse.label: LIVE / on-page-now vs snapshot generated_at
live_pulse.fail: NOT LIVE — last snapshot values; never invented
live_pulse.note: Browser JSON-RPC. publicnode first because api.mainnet-beta.solana.com 403s GitHub Pages Origin; publicnode CORS *. Same two keyless endpoints as generate.py. At most every 60s. Not a GitHub Actions tick.

dex.change_7d_meaning: percent change of 24h DEX volume vs the 24h from 7 days ago (not 7d-total vs prior 7d)

rwa.source: defillama.protocols chainTvls.Solana where category in {RWA, RWA Lending}

active_addresses.note: solana.com/data publishes several vendor series for the same label. Values disagree; Borealis does not average them.

sampled.source: Solana RPC getBlock meta.fee (finalized, time-stratified sample)
sampled.note: NOT a 24h census. Time-stratified getBlock sample: 0 adjacent tip blocks (spot) + 0 slots spread over a ~2–3h target window (target 10800s; ≤160 txs/slot subsampled). n_tx=0 all-tx, n_nonvote=0, window_seconds=None. p50 is all-tx meta.fee; non-vote p50 is separate. Do not read n=0 as a 24h ledger — wall-clock window is unknowns.

economics.median_tx_fee_note: NOT a 24h census. Time-stratified getBlock sample: 0 adjacent tip blocks (spot) + 0 slots spread over a ~2–3h target window (target 10800s; ≤160 txs/slot subsampled). n_tx=0 all-tx, n_nonvote=0, window_seconds=None. p50 is all-tx meta.fee; non-vote p50 is separate. Do not read n=0 as a 24h ledger — wall-clock window is unknowns.

jito.tips_24h_note: INVALID 24h run-rate = landed tip-floor p50 (0.00000137 SOL) × non-vote TPS (1420) × 86400. tip_floor is a per-bundle landed percentile, not paid by every non-vote tx, and is not a 24h Jito tape. Not included in headline REV. Not added from DeFiLlama.
jito.sensitivity: sensitivity (NOT a 24h aggregate, NOT headline REV): invalid run-rate at p50 floor → 16313 USD; at p95 floor → 344484 USD.
jito.sensitivity_note: sensitivity (NOT a 24h aggregate, NOT headline REV): invalid run-rate at p50 floor → 16313 USD; at p95 floor → 344484 USD.

jito_runrate_not_rev.note: INVALID 24h run-rate = landed tip-floor p50 (0.00000137 SOL) × non-vote TPS (1420) × 86400. tip_floor is a per-bundle landed percentile, not paid by every non-vote tx, and is not a 24h Jito tape. Not included in headline REV. Not added from DeFiLlama.
jito_runrate_not_rev.label: INVALID as a 24h aggregate — tip_floor is per-bundle landed percentile, not paid by every non-vote tx

economics.rev_definition: Full network REV (Blockworks/Helius) is in-protocol transaction fees (vote + base + priority) plus out-of-protocol Jito MEV tips. Jito tape: GET kobe.mainnet.jito.network/api/v1/daily_mev_rewards (no key). Gross tips = jito_tips + validator_tips (Jito-paid/retained vs validator-distributed; not inclusive; split is not a TipRouter fee rate). UTC calendar day, aligned to solana.com/data Fees date. REV USD uses that same day's solana.com/data SOL Price, not the live snapshot. Never mix dates. tip_floor × TPS is NOT REV. DeFiLlama protocol/application fees are NOT REV.
economics.rev_kind: MEASURED UTC calendar day 2026-09-14: in-protocol fees + gross Jito MEV tips (jito_tips + validator_tips; not a rolling 24h); USD uses solana.com/data SOL Price (DexPaprika) UTC 2026-09-14
economics.rev_sensitivity: sensitivity (NOT a 24h aggregate, NOT headline REV): invalid run-rate at p50 floor → 16313 USD; at p95 floor → 344484 USD.

rev_components.label: Jito tip-floor run-rate (NOT REV)
rev_components.source: INVALID 24h run-rate = landed tip-floor p50 (0.00000137 SOL) × non-vote TPS (1420) × 86400. tip_floor is a per-bundle landed percentile, not paid by every non-vote tx, and is not a 24h Jito tape. Not included in headline REV. Not added from DeFiLlama.

rev_routes_tried.route: getBlock stratified sample run-rate (sum meta.fee / window_seconds × 86400)
rev_routes_tried.role: ESTIMATED in-protocol cross-check, not added (would double-count solana.com Fees)
INVALID as a 24h aggregate — sensitivity only, not headline REV
INVALID sensitivity only, not summed into REV
EXCLUDED — application/protocol fees, not network REV
MEASURED Jito gross MEV tips UTC day (jito_tips+validator_tips)

economics.total_rev_note: Full network REV (Blockworks/Helius) is in-protocol transaction fees (vote + base + priority) plus out-of-protocol Jito MEV tips. Jito tape: GET kobe.mainnet.jito.network/api/v1/daily_mev_rewards (no key). Gross tips = jito_tips + validator_tips (Jito-paid/retained vs validator-distributed; not inclusive; split is not a TipRouter fee rate). UTC calendar day, aligned to solana.com/data Fees date. REV USD uses that same day's solana.com/data SOL Price, not the live snapshot. Never mix dates. tip_floor × TPS is NOT REV. DeFiLlama protocol/application fees are NOT REV. This run: MEASURED UTC calendar day 2026-09-14: in-protocol fees + gross Jito MEV tips (jito_tips + validator_tips; not a rolling 24h); USD uses solana.com/data SOL Price (DexPaprika) UTC 2026-09-14. Protocol fees 14217472.459999997 USD are listed separately and excluded.
economics.rev_spot_note: spot equivalent at this run SOL-USD; not the headline REV USD

jito_daily.accounting: gross_mev_tips_sol = jito_tips + validator_tips (jito_tips = Jito-paid/retained; validator_tips = validator-distributed; separate components, not inclusive; split is not a TipRouter protocol-fee rate)

parts.detail: mean slot 316 ms vs live SIMD-0525 300 ms gate (300→30, 600→0)
TPS 3,552 vs solana.com/data Transaction Count (Total)|Allium / 86400 3,874 (ratio capped at 1.0)

250ms slots activation now pending on mainnet-beta.

400 → 350 → 300 → 250ms

Reminder, SIMD-0525 features take effect one epoch after they activate thus will go live at the epoch 1037 boundary ~05:01 UTC, Friday Sept 18.

- epoch 1035: pending activation
- epoch 1036: feature active
- epoch 1037: 250ms slots live

1 more step to 200ms.

items.title:
Indexers, paymasters, and anyone reading priority fees: read transactionConfig instead of ComputeBudget instructions. Compute budget instructions are ignored for configuration in V1, so scanning them may return zero or misleading values for V1 transactions.

RPC operators: run v4.2.2 or v4.3.0-beta.3 to serve the larger size.

primary_source.title: Solana Changelog: August 20, 2026
primary_source.role: first-party changelog: Feature gates reduced mainnet 400ms to 350ms
primary_source.quote: Feature gates reduced mainnet slot times from 400ms to 350ms, while Testnet moved from 250ms to 200ms.

stale_secondary.note: solana.com/upgrades/reduced-slot-times may still list 400 ms; do not copy that as live cluster status.

gates.method: getAccountInfo Feature accounts (encoding=base64). effective_epoch = epoch(activated_slot) + 1. Observed mean slot is corroboration only — never gate proof.
gates.changelog_quote: Feature gates reduced mainnet slot times from 400ms to 350ms, while Testnet moved from 250ms to 200ms.
gates.disclaimer: Do not treat observed ~367 ms as proof the 350 ms gate is live. Do not copy solana.com/upgrades/reduced-slot-times if it lists 400 ms as current.

editorial.summary: First-party Solana Changelog: August 20, 2026: “Feature gates reduced mainnet slot times from 400ms to 350ms, while Testnet moved from 250ms to 200ms.” On-chain Feature accounts: 400ms=superseded, 350ms=live, 300ms=live, 250ms=pending, 200ms=pending. Observed mean slot ~316 ms is corroboration only — not feature-gate proof. Alpenglow (SIMD-0326) remains the consensus rewrite (Votor / Rotor); it is a separate track from the slot-time feature gates.

simds.name: Markers for Alpenglow Fast Leader Handover
BLS Pubkey Management in Vote Account

timeline_public.item: Solana Changelog: August 20, 2026: “Feature gates reduced mainnet slot times from 400ms to 350ms, while Testnet moved from 250ms to 200ms.”
solana.com/news “Lowering Slot Time and Validators Economic” remains a listing-token write-up for SIMD-525 (SIMD-0525).
SIMD-0525 created (Anza). Four feature gates: 350/300/250/200 ms.
Observed mean slot ~316 ms is corroboration only — not feature-gate proof. INFERRED corroboration, not a feature-gate RPC.
SIMD-0387 (BLS pubkey in vote account) activated on mainnet.
SIMD-0357 VAT activated. VAT does not itself turn on Alpenglow consensus.

watch: Whether the 300 ms gate (effective epoch 1024 when activated at epoch-1023 start) is live once that epoch starts.
Skip rate / skipped slots as later 50 ms steps (250/200) get Feature accounts on mainnet.
Do not treat observed slot ms as activation proof.
Firedancer / Frankendancer Votor parity before a full Alpenswitch.
editorial.disclaimer: Editorial. Gate labels come from getAccountInfo Feature accounts (effective epoch = activation epoch + 1). Observed slot ms is INFERRED corroboration, not proof. Ignore solana.com/upgrades/reduced-slot-times if it lists 400 ms as current.

tx_fees.source: Solana RPC getBlock meta.fee (finalized, time-stratified sample)
tx_fees.note: NOT a 24h census. Time-stratified getBlock sample: 0 adjacent tip blocks (spot) + 0 slots spread over a ~2–3h target window (target 10800s; ≤160 txs/slot subsampled). n_tx=0 all-tx, n_nonvote=0, window_seconds=None. p50 is all-tx meta.fee; non-vote p50 is separate. Do not read n=0 as a 24h ledger — wall-clock window is unknowns.

omitted: priced up to 80 of 800 Solana-deployed symbols (HTTP budget). Priced-subset lower bound, not a census.
xstocks.count_meaning: 800 unique xStocks names with a Solana deployment (catalog; 1:1 with unique underlyings in current API; 800 unique underlyings among 800 Solana rows; not every tokenized equity on Solana).
xstocks.solana_share_label: 800 of 800 listed xStocks have a Solana deployment (800 unique underlyings). Count share, not market-cap share.
xstocks.multiplier_note: Live currentMultiplier from /public/assets/{sym}/multiplier?network=Solana. If the fetch fails or currentMultiplier is missing: multiplier=None, mcap_usd=None (never silent 1.0).
xstocks.mcap_note: Priced-subset lower bound: quote × circulating × live currentMultiplier over 14 of 800 Solana-deployed listed symbols (multiplier ok 80/80; 800 unique underlyings; attempted 80). Not a 715-name census, and not a census of every tokenized equity on Solana. Missing currentMultiplier → mcap omitted (never silent 1.0).

llama.name: xStocks
llama.note: DeFiLlama protocol/xstocks Solana TVL None. 0 tokens in the latest TVL breakdown — a liquidity census, not 24h volume.

xstocks.volume_7d_note: 7d omitted: Jupiter lite-api exposes stats5m/1h/6h/24h, not 7d. DeFiLlama protocol/xstocks has TVL (liquidity), not a volume series. No no-key 7d tokenized-equity volume answered this run — not invented.
xstocks.volume_kind: Jupiter-reported xStocks subset 24h activity (stats24h buy+sell per mint; a swap is buy XOR sell of that mint, not a double-count; not all 715, not all Solana DEX)
xstocks.volume_coverage: Jupiter-reported xStocks subset 24h activity (stats24h buy+sell per mint; a swap is buy XOR sell of that mint, not a double-count; not all 800, not all Solana DEX; 20 matched mints).
